title: On the Impact of Random Seeds on the Fairness of Clinical Classifiers

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the mean differences in model performance (AUC) and calculating recall, parity, and specificity gaps between male and female patients across different random seeds in clinical prediction tasks.

Measuring the mean differences in model performance (AUC) and calculating recall, parity, and specificity gaps across different racial and ethnic groups (e.g., White, Black, Asian, Hispanic) across different random seeds in clinical prediction tasks.
Calculating recall, parity, and specificity gaps between English-speaking and non-English-speaking patients across different random seeds in clinical prediction tasks.

Calculating recall, parity, and specificity gaps across different health insurance statuses (Medicare, Private, Medicaid) as a proxy for socioeconomic status across different random seeds in clinical prediction tasks.
